**Waves behind the home screen**

The home screen now shows slow waves in the colours of your theme by default: ridges in layers with contour lines, from the page's colour to a muted accent, in the same square dither as before. They drift gently, stay faint where the settings are written, and stop when the window is behind another one. Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ **Animate the background** keeps them still, as Reduce motion does.
